# Feature: Live run UI

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #23 -->

## Intent
During a measurement the developer must see which phase is running and be able to abort (FR-018, SCN-009). RunPhaseStepper uses aria-live sparingly; logs are expandable.

## Preconditions
- Dashboard shell (#21)
- Local API REST + SSE (#20)
- Abort cleanup marks cancelled as not baseline (#40)

## Happy Path
- [x] Phase changes are visible with named operation text (not spinner-only)
- [x] Abort control exists and is keyboard-operable
- [x] After abort, status is cancelled and the run is not baseline-eligible
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] SSE drop → reconnect with Last-Event-ID, then show final status
- [x] Abort of an already completed run is 409 / no status lie
- [x] Missing token → 401 on abort

## Regression
- [ ] Existing SSE Last-Event-ID / 410 tests still pass when hold is 0
- [ ] Token not in localStorage
- [ ] Scope: `apps/dashboard` live/new run + `packages/local-api` abort — no Compare, no Finding detail, no timeline zoom

## Assumptions
- Run execution remains an in-memory stub; `runHoldMs` keeps the stream open so abort is observable
- UI copy is English
- EventSource cannot send Authorization; the client parses SSE via `fetch`

## Security Coverage
- F-01 waived (loopback)
- F-03: token in memory only
- B-03: abort requires the run token
- P-02: errors do not include the token

## Implementation Notes
- Dashboard `/runs/new` starts a stub Quick Scan; `/runs/:id/live` shows RunPhaseStepper, logs, Abort run.
- SSE is consumed via `fetch` (Authorization header). Last-Event-ID reconnect; GET run is the status fallback.
- `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/abort` sets `cancelled` and `baselineEligible: false`. `runHoldMs` keeps the stub stream open so abort is observable; tests default to 0 (previous SSE/410 behavior).
- 113 tests; `pnpm checks` green.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: start run → SSE/poll phases → abort → one cancelled run, not baseline (cardinality 1).
- Missing token fail closed. No queue.
